free_tier.stated: USD 10/year for the Micro plan: 1 shared vCPU on an Intel Xeon Gold, 1 GB DDR4, 15 GB SSD, in Dallas, Nuremberg or Singapore, with a 250-app one-click catalogue, automatic HTTPS and custom domains, per-app CIDR allow-listing, one-click app updates, transactional email with SPF and DKIM, snapshots on a daily or weekly schedule, health-check monitoring with email alerts, and a container terminal, SFTP and app logs. The app count is limited only by the resources. A separate option puts the same panel on the customer's own server. This is app hosting and not a VPS: the thread says so directly.
